description: Gives a chat-triggered agent live read access to the Microsoft Teams thread it's answering, plus (optionally) which knowledge-base receipts a past bot reply in it was built from.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

teams_tenant_id_env_var.label: Teams Tenant Id Env Var
teams_tenant_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD tenant id.

teams_client_id_env_var.label: Teams Client Id Env Var
teams_client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client id.

teams_client_secret_env_var.label: Teams Client Secret Env Var
teams_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Azure AD app registration client secret.

teams_refresh_token_env_var.label: Teams Refresh Token Env Var
teams_refresh_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the INITIAL OAuth refresh token (see teams_run_request_sensor's README, 'Auth').

oauth_state_dir.label: Oauth State Dir
oauth_state_dir.description: Local path or fsspec URI dedicated to this server's '.teams_oauth_state.json' (a rotated refresh token, if Microsoft ever issues one). Can be the SAME directory teams_agent_request_sensor uses -- they share nothing in code, but rotation state for the same Entra app/account is safe to share.

team_id_template.label: Team Id Template
team_id_template.description: Template string for this spawned server's TEAMS_CHAT_TOOLS_TEAM_ID env value -- the calling agent's own {tag.<key>} substitution resolves it at run time. Set to a literal team id instead if every run should always read the same fixed team.

channel_id_template.label: Channel Id Template
channel_id_template.description: Template string for this spawned server's TEAMS_CHAT_TOOLS_CHANNEL_ID env value, same mechanism as team_id_template.

thread_id_template.label: Thread Id Template
thread_id_template.description: Template string for this spawned server's TEAMS_CHAT_TOOLS_THREAD_ID env value, same mechanism as team_id_template.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

receipts_db_path.label: Receipts Db Path
receipts_db_path.description: SQLite file path -- the SAME receipts_db_path a teams_reply instance (and the knowledge_search_server/hybrid_knowledge_search_server the agent calls) are configured with. When set, get_thread() attaches receipt_ids to any BOT-authored message in the thread (a prior reply from this same chat agent, looked up via teams_reply's own receipt-message link table).

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings. *_template fields are passed through VERBATIM as env values -- resolved by the calling agent's own {tag.*} substitution at run time, not by this component. Leave unset to skip this -- existing resource_key-only behavior is unchanged.
